open.trigger: Fresh profile with DSH_MEGA_INTEGRATED_DOCK=1 and expanded dock
open.observed: The dock covers most of the first-run beta disclosure Continue control; an exposed left portion remained clickable. The default hidden-dock startup was not implicated.
open.rootCause: The official DSH page is the BrowserWindow's own full-width document rather than a separately bounded child view; the reserved officialWidth cannot constrain its centered modal.
open.decision: Not repaired in this RC. A safe correction requires a bounded official-surface layout change and requalification; a CSS or pixel-offset patch would not establish correct behavior.

unconfirmedObservations.observed: Scheduler verification copy said `重启后生效` while Scheduler was already LOADED.
unconfirmedObservations.decision: No matching source-level string or proven behavior mismatch was established; copy was not changed speculatively.

unconfirmedObservations.observed: One aggregate Mega health view showed 27 loaded, 1 unhealthy, and 1 off; the unhealthy identity was not established by retained evidence.
unconfirmedObservations.decision: Do not claim every installed plugin is healthy; identify the module on a future targeted review.
unconfirmedObservations.evidence: Visible journey observation; no current failure is attributed to a named plugin.
